answer: Locks are entered in garden, expire in yarrow, and whisper lists each expiry. An farming party running 199 aliases therefore needs 145 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4880 identities would post 3264 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
